pageCache.text:
Welcome to Northlands Wood Primary Academy
We are a vibrant, exciting and forward thinking school which currently welcomes in over 400 children each day.
No two days are the same at Northlands Wood, mainly due to the vast array of opportunities we provide for our young people and the diverse and rich curriculum we operate. Children regularly go home ‘buzzing’ from their day and feedback from parents continually celebrates how happy their children are in school. Being a happy school is important to us and something we pride ourselves on having. It is vital for the children and essential for our staff. Our pupils get so much out of their time with us because our staff are prepared to put so much in. Everyone is valued and everyone is encouraged to grow, develop and flourish.
We have key values which are at the heart of everything we do. Children work in conjunction to demonstrate these values and there is a celebration at the end of each term to mark this collaborative success. As a result of this ethos, our children are happy, resilient, well-rounded and motivated to learn and develop. Teaching and learning at our school fosters an inclusive, holistic approach to education that totally engages all children and celebrates equality and diversity.
Learning at Northlands Wood is regularly taken outside the classroom. We are proud of our ‘flourishing’ Forest School programme which balances our curriculum and gives members of our school community the chance to get back in touch with the nature surrounding us. We feel our bi-weekly Head Teacher Updates reflects our dynamic, busy and action-packed approach to learning, so please take the time to have a look through these.
For further information, please contact the School Office on 01444 455653 or email office@northlandswood.co.uk who will be happy to help you.
Jeremy WayHeadteacher

pageCache.text:
SENDIAS Parent ProtocoL
At Northlands Wood Primary Academy, we take our relationships with our parents of children with special educational needs and/or disabilities very seriously.
One of the agencies we work closely with is SENDIAS (SEND Information, Advice and Support Service who provide support and practical help to our parents.
More information about SENDIAS can be found via West Sussex Local Offer - https://westsussex.local-offer.org.

pageCache.pageTitle: Northlands Wood Primary Academy - Breakfast/After School Club
pageCache.text:
Breakfast/After School Club
At Northlands Wood Primary School, we have a Breakfast Club which provides a nourishing, healthy breakfast and child care from 7.30am until 8.40am.
We also operate an After-School Club known as 'Treehouse' which offers childcare with a snack and/or a light meal each day from 3.15pm until 6.00pm (term-time only).
Places are limited and pre-booking and payment have to be made with our Extended Schools Supervisor prior to attendance.
From Monday 01 September 2025, prices are as follows:-
Category A (15.15 - 18.00) = £17.50
Category B (16.15 - 18.00) = £15.00 *supporting children attending clubs after school*
Category C (15.15 - 17.00) = £12.50
Category A and B continue to provide a home cooked hot meal which will be served to children around 5pm. An example weekly menu would look similar to this:-
Sausages, chips, vegetables and gravy
Pasta bolognese and garlic bread
Fish fingers, potato waffles and baked beans
Jacket potato with tuna and/or cheese
Breakfast club is £7.50 for the session which runs from 07.30 - 08.40. This provides children with cereal, toast and fresh fruit each day.
For all information about Breakfast and After School Clubs and to check about availability, please contact Mrs Panico on treehouse@northlandswood.co.uk.

Admissions
Admission to Northlands Wood Primary Academy is administered through West Sussex County Council. We have included a link to West Sussex admissions page on their website: here you will find all the information you should need and a link to the online application process.
Click here to access West Sussex Admissions Page
Click here to look at the NWPA Admissions Policy.
If you require help with the admissions process, please contact Jane Graham or Izzy Sommerville by ringing the school office (01444 455653) or you can call West Sussex admissions department on 0845 075 1007.
We warmly welcome visits to the school, please contact the office to arrange a date and time.
The Governors of Northlands Wood Primary Academy and the Trustees of Sussex Learning Trust are required to consult on the admissions oversubscription criteria every 7 years, irrespective of whether they are considering amending the categories or not. Please find an email giving more details:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JCGD__SX9pbAKfcZRuYxLl2wUWTwXzTDUthhMePlAS4/edit?usp=sharing
